# case-sensitive-ini-loader

Behavior contract:
load_settings(text) returns {section_name: {option_name: string_value}} for an INI document. Preserve option name case and literal percent signs: interpolation is disabled. DEFAULT values are inherited by sections, but DEFAULT itself is not returned. Empty documents return {}. Invalid INI must raise configparser.Error, with duplicate options rejected.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
